ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the Trump administration's decision to withhold funds.
questions: What are the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the withholding of funds affect healthcare services in the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and abuse in the Medicaid system. It requires a thorough analysis of public records and interviews with key stakeholders.
